vibe: High-tech, CLI/Terminal aesthetic, professional developer tool, raw capability, cyberpunk but clean

rules: No standard sans (Inter, Roboto) for headings.
Headings should use `tracking-tight` and bold weights.
Use uppercase with wide tracking `tracking-[0.2em]` for overlines and section labels (e.g., 'SYSTEM LOGS', 'INTEGRATIONS').
Line height: `leading-none` for headings, `leading-relaxed` for UI body text.
Sizes: H1 (text-3xl/4xl for dashboard panels), H2 (text-xl), body (text-sm/text-base).
Never use pure #000000 without texture or 1px subtle borders defining boundaries.
Primary Accent (Terminal Green) is for active status, executing states, and primary CTAs.
Secondary Accent (Amber) is for RAG reasoning, background tasks, and warnings.
Always set hover text color explicitly: `hover:bg-zinc-900 hover:text-green-400`.
Every pixel utilized. Use `h-full` to stretch panels.
Dense data correlation.
Desktop view: Left sidebar (history), Center (chat/code execution), Right Sidebar (integrations/RAG).
Containers with borders must have internal padding.
Mobile-first, but optimized heavily for wide desktop terminal views.
Use pure flat solid backgrounds. No glassmorphism, no soft shadows.
Cards/Panels: Flat background, 1px subtle border (`border-zinc-800`), no radius (`rounded-none` or max `rounded-sm`).
Headers: Solid backgrounds with a hard 1px bottom border.
Active/Focus states: Glow effects with drop-shadows on borders, e.g., `drop-shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(0,229,89,0.5)]`.

components.buttons: Square edges, ghost or outline styles preferred. Primary button uses solid green with black text. Include `data-testid`.
components.inputs: Flat, transparent backgrounds with 1px border. Focus state turns border to accent green.
components.chat_bubbles: No standard chat bubbles. Use CLI line format: user input prefixed with `>` and AI output prefixed with `AJAX:` or rendering markdown plainly.
components.status_cards: Use for integrations (Gmail, WA, IG, X). Display pulsing dot (green = connected, gray/red = disconnected).
components.code_blocks: Dark background (`#0A0A0A`), syntax highlighting, strictly monospaced. Top bar with language label and 'Copy' button.

rules: Animations should be mechanical and fast (0.15s ease), not bouncy.
Use typewriter effect or fast sequential loading for AI streaming responses.
Focus states MUST have high contrast (e.g., `focus:ring-1 focus:ring-green-500`).

icons_assets.icon_strategy: lucide-react for system icons, react-icons for integration brands (FaGithub, FaGoogle, FaInstagram, FaTwitter, FaWhatsapp)

image_urls.description: Dark LED grid for subtle background overlay on empty states
Abstract black and amber network texture for the RAG reasoning visualization panel

rules: All interactive elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute. Format: kebab-case, role-based.
Examples: `data-testid="chat-input"`, `data-testid="send-message-btn"`, `data-testid="connect-gmail-btn"`.

instructions_to_main_agent: Initialize React with Vite, Tailwind CSS, and Shadcn UI (already present).
Install `react-icons` for specific brand icons (Gmail/Google, WhatsApp, Instagram, X/Twitter).
Implement a 3-pane layout for Desktop: Sidebar (History), Main Area (Chat/Code Sandbox), Right Panel (Integrations/RAG logs).
For the chat interface, avoid 'iMessage bubble' styles. Use a developer/CLI format with markdown rendering.
Implement a dedicated tab or split-pane in the main area for the Code Execution output.
Build 'Integration Status Cards' using Shadcn components, stripping default soft shadows and rounding. Use sharp corners and glowing green/red dots for status.
Ensure `JetBrains Mono` and `IBM Plex Sans` are imported via Google Fonts.
